summary.text: Timothy Long, a U.S. Taxpayers Party candidate, lost the November 3, 2026 election for U.S. Senate in Michigan to Abdul El-Sayed.
Little public information about him was found, and he had not completed Ballotpedia's 2026 survey.

paragraphs.text: Long previously ran for Wayne County Commission District 14 in 2024 as the U.S. Taxpayers Party candidate, receiving 14.3% (6,513 votes) in a race won by incumbent Alex Garza.
In July 2026 he advanced from the party's convention to the Senate ballot.
He received 0.6% of the vote to Abdul El-Sayed's 52.5%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
